positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description: I worked with system requirements. Responsible for validating systems functional requirements with the INCOSE standard for atomic requirements. I also used model based system engineering and design for six sigma. With these I tested the system requirements for conflicts and unintended programming.
positions.insights: Model-based Systems Engineering (MBSE), INCOSE and +3 skills

positions.title: R&D Intern
positions.description: I was responsible for gathering research on advanced driver assisted system (ADAS) sensors. Such as LiDAR, RADAR, and Ultrasound. I also helped with the assembly of a light-weight door. With the light-weight door project I was invited to observe a FMVSS static 214 test. This summer internship furthered my knowledge of the automotive industry, and put an emphasis on just how important the OEM Supplier relationship is to constructing automobiles.

positions.title: Chasier
positions.description: I was employed as a cashier, and provided excellent customer service. I worked with many kinds of people, and learned how to gently guide customers to the items they need.

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Sience: Electrical and Computer Engineering with a minor in Physics
